lines.en: I patrol the lake along the shoreline.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴游，让水自己进来。
lines.en: I swim open-mouthed, letting water in.

lines.zh: 我半米长，水草挡不住我。
lines.en: Half a metre long; the weeds cannot stop me.

lines.zh: 三条一群，我们压着水底走。
lines.en: Three of us hug the bottom as we go.

lines.zh: 河口的缓流是我的地盘。
lines.en: The slow current at the river mouth is mine.
One tailbeat carries me a long way.
I avoid the rocks and take the deep channel.
Warm spring water makes me roam most.

lines.zh: 我跟着你踩出的浑水走。
lines.en: I follow the mud you kicked up.
Fish ahead; I speed up half a block.
I make one full turn through the lake centre.

lines.zh: 水面的光被我背脊切开。
lines.en: My back cuts the light on the surface.

lines.zh: 我游得不快，但从不改道。
lines.en: I am not fast, but I never change course.

lines.zh: 一米长的老鲈走过这条路。
lines.en: A metre-long elder once swam this route.

lines.zh: 我冲出水面叼虫，又落回原处。
lines.en: I break the surface for a bug and drop back.

lines.zh: 湖底有沉木，我从上面越过去。
lines.en: A sunken log below; I glide over it.

lines.zh: 水浑的时候，我靠侧线走。
lines.en: When the water muddies, I steer by my lateral line.

lines.zh: 五条一起走，影子叠成一片。
lines.en: Five of us move as one; our shadows merge.

lines.zh: 我悬在浅滩上，等鱼靠近。
lines.en: I hover over the shallows, waiting.
The lake lies flat as sheet iron.

lines.zh: 我张合着嘴，试水的味道。
lines.en: I work my jaw, tasting the water.

lines.zh: 我的背是暗绿的，藏在草里。
lines.en: Dark green above, hidden in the weeds.

lines.zh: 岸上有东西在走，我不动。
lines.en: Something walks the bank; I hold still.

lines.zh: 我在算一条小鱼的距离。
lines.en: I am measuring the distance to a minnow.

lines.zh: 阳光到了我这一层，变软了。
lines.en: Sunlight reaches my depth and softens.
A bubble rises from the lake mud.
I spread my fins and hold position.

lines.zh: 我听见自己的心跳，很慢。
lines.en: I hear my own heartbeat, slow.

lines.zh: 我要长到一米，还差很多。
lines.en: A metre is my goal; I am far from it.
The weeds sway along my flank.
I wait for dusk, when fish are plenty.

lines.zh: 我嘴里含着半口水，不咽。
lines.en: I hold half a mouthful without swallowing.

lines.zh: 你站在岸上，比我高太多。
lines.en: You stand on the bank, far too tall.
I know that rod in your hand.
I look up; you are backlit.
You look down; I look up.

lines.zh: 你的胶靴正往烂泥里沉。
lines.en: Your boots are sinking into the rotten mud.
I am not afraid of you. I am large.
Your shadow scatters the small fish.

lines.zh: 我在你脚边那块石头旁转圈。
lines.en: I circle the stone beside your feet.
When you shift, my fins tighten.

lines.zh: 我看着你的手，不看你的脸。
lines.en: I watch your hands, not your face.
Who bit me? I turn and answer.
My scales are torn up.
My blood is in the water.
Pain only makes me meaner.
I hit a stone and my sight darkens.
Half my body has gone numb.
I retreat into the weeds and gulp water.

lines.zh: 这一下打穿了我的侧线。
lines.en: That blow wrecked my lateral line.
I am still here. Not dead yet.
I will remember that smell.
That lure hops and hops.
I could swallow it whole, and I know it.
It smells of worm, but is not worm.
I circle behind it and look again.
My kin grabs; I will not allow it.
This channel answers to me.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，量了量它的宽度。
lines.en: I open my jaw and measure its width.

lines.zh: 钓者的手在抖，我看见了。
lines.en: The angler's hand trembles. I see it.
I bump it, and it bounces away.
I take the bait, never the hook.

lines.zh: 你踩进我的水，泥全起来了。
lines.en: You step into my water and raise the mud.
Who bumped me? I turn to bite.
Half a metre of me does not yield.
The water by your legs churns.
I get shoved into the weeds.
Bump me and you do not just leave.

lines.zh: 岸边的石头硌了我一下。
lines.en: A bank stone scrapes my side.
I push back, and it is not gentle.
I knock a schoolmate half a block aside.
The splash reaches your face.

lines.zh: 你也是这湖里的大家伙？
lines.en: Are you a big one in this lake too?
Let us circle the lake side by side.
You are broader than me. I accept it.
This deep channel fits us both.
I will not bite you. Not today.

lines.zh: 跟着我留下的那道水痕。
lines.en: Follow the wake I leave behind.

lines.zh: 我们的群已经有五条了。
lines.en: Our school already counts five.
I give you the shallows.
Let us guard this river mouth together.
Your scale colour suits mine.

lines.zh: 一块鱼肉沉下来，我吞了。
lines.en: A chunk of fish sinks; I swallow it.
Big enough to be worth opening my jaw.
I clamp down and shake my head twice.

lines.zh: 没什么味，我照样吞下去。
lines.en: Little taste, but I swallow it anyway.
This mouthful beats a whole minnow.

lines.zh: 我把它顶到石头底下藏好。
lines.en: I wedge it under a stone for later.
The current takes half; I give chase.
I gulp too hard and my jaw aches.
The scraps go to the smaller ones.
Chewing changes nothing; my teeth only grip.
Something splits the surface.
A big thing has entered the water.
The small fish dive into the weeds.

lines.zh: 我的领地里有个陌生的影子。
lines.en: A stranger's shadow is in my territory.
It is broader than I am.

lines.zh: 我听见钩子落水的声音。
lines.en: I hear a hook enter the water.
Who casts a net at my river mouth?
I swim to its flank to look.
This channel holds one master only.
I open my jaw first.
I face it squarely.
I move to its blind side.
It shifts; I count its scales.
My fins stiffen like boards.
Three blocks. Close enough.
I make no sound. Bass do not call.
I drop half a block lower.
If it turns, I back off.
I count silently: one, two.
The lake water goes quiet.
I bite into its flank.
Four hearts will buy me a few blows.
My teeth hook in and hold.
I shake my head and drag it off balance.

lines.zh: 这一撞带着半米的体重。
lines.en: Half a metre of weight behind that ram.
I slap its eye with my tail.
I bite, then fall back into the weeds.
It is bigger than me. I know.
I snap at its shadow and miss.
The water beats into white foam.

lines.zh: 我在河口的缓流里出现。
lines.en: I appear in the slow current of the mouth.

lines.zh: 水面上方四十格是天空。
lines.en: Forty blocks of sky hang above the surface.

lines.zh: 这里有四条同类，正好一群。
lines.en: Four kin here, a proper school.

lines.zh: 我出生就占了一块石头。
lines.en: I claim a stone the moment I arrive.
It is spring. The water is warm.

lines.zh: 我第一眼看见的是水草。
lines.en: The first thing I see is weed.

lines.zh: 这条河常见像我这样的鱼。
lines.en: Common fish like me fill this river.
I test the current; it is soft.

lines.zh: 我把背脊露出水面一寸。
lines.en: I show an inch of back above water.
The lake is big. I take a first lap.

lines.zh: 上层的水在烧，我拼命下潜。
lines.en: The upper water burns; I dive desperately.

lines.zh: 水从高处倒下来，我摔懵了。
lines.en: Water pours from above; I land hard.
Dragged ashore, my gills press the mud.
The blast opens the water; I tumble.

lines.zh: 箭入水就慢了，还是扎进我。
lines.en: The arrow slows in water and still hits.

lines.zh: 一股凉念钻进我的骨头。
lines.en: A cold thought seeps into my bones.
Starving, I cannot be bothered to chase.
Lightning strikes the surface; all goes white.
The water is gone; I beat at air.
